title: Easiest vector-DB knowledge base: NotebookLM
description: Here's the easiest vector database knowledge base you can give your AI agents, and you don't need to set up RAG or a Supabase vector DB or anything. The answer is NotebookLM. Its whole job is to store your documents and let an AI synthesize across them, which is exactly what 99% of agent memory actually needs. You just connect your coding agent to the NotebookLM MCP server and you're done. In a lot of cases it's a better vector DB than one you'd build yourself, because you're leaning on Google's entire product team for semantic search across thousands of documents, the retrieval is pre-filtered through your free Gemini credits so you're not dumping raw responses and burning tokens, and you get segmented projects for different zones of memory plus all the infographic, slide and video generation on top. If you haven't connected your agent to NotebookLM yet, do it. Link in bio.
